title: Student-GenAI teaming final project
summary: Freshman non-majors create a novel software, hardware, web, art, or other product by teaming with one or more GenAI tools. They submit the product, process evidence, full AI transcripts, a critical reflection, and a three-minute demonstration, with grading that rewards substantial personal contribution.

sources.title: Fostering Creativity: Student-Generative AI Teaming in an Open-Ended CS0 Assignment
sources.evidence_quote: The AI Final Project is your opportunity to explore and team up with an artificial intelligence tool to create something cool and inspiring.

context.learner_level: first-year undergraduate students, predominantly non-computing majors

assessment.summary: Create a working product or prototype that demonstrates meaningful collaboration between the student and GenAI.
student_actions: Propose a project and obtain instructor approval.
Use one or more GenAI tools to create a product.
Make a substantial personal contribution beyond raw AI output.
Document prompts, responses, and work in progress.
Reflect on AI contributions, copyright, strengths, and limitations.

outputs.artifact: Source files or other project artifacts

student_role.description: Teaming with GenAI is mandatory, but the project must require meaningful student work and not be achievable by AI in a few prompts.

prohibited_actions: Submitting a product produced essentially entirely by AI
Using AI as the only source of artistic expression

grading.method: Instructor grading of product, presentation, reflection, creativity, and student contribution.

criteria.criterion: Personal contribution to the human-AI team

reported_results: 91% of students used ChatGPT, approximately 14% used two AI tools, and 2% used three.
Projects included software, hardware, websites, art, and other products.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

evidence_excerpts.quote: The AI Final Project is your opportunity to explore and team up with an artificial intelligence tool to create something cool and inspiring.
The AI Final Project is your opportunity to explore and team up with an artificial intelligence tool to create something cool and inspiring.
Students were required to team with generative AI to create something beyond what they alone (or the AI alone) could accomplish.

Regardless of their project choice, students were required to provide full transcripts of their conversations with AI, screenshots of work in progress, and turn in any source code or other artifacts they created.
Upon completion, students submitted a short written critical analysis documenting their experiences and presented a three-minute demonstration of their project in class.
